materials.quote: Language Proficiency Requirements: Please submit one or more of the following documents.

materials.note: official documents proving loss of Korean citizenship; only if the applicant or parents renounced it
materials.quote: Both the applicant and applicant’s parent(s) should submit official documents to prove their loss of Korean citizenship.

materials.quote: A recommendation letter for the language proficiency from the Department is required.

materials.note: GRE general test
materials.quote:
GRE Requirements
Yes, general test

materials.note: proof of English proficiency; if English is not the first language
materials.quote: If English is not your first language, you’ll need to provide proof of your English proficiency before you can be given an offer to study at UNSW.

materials.note: showing prior work experience and roles
materials.quote: Provide your CV/resume clearly showing your prior work experience and roles that you have held.

materials.note: appendix form for the academic assessors; if the Bachelor's degree is from a non-Danish university
materials.quote: If you hold a Bachelor’s degree from a non-Danish university, you must complete the appendix below and upload it to the application portal.

materials.note: statement of purpose: reasons for interest in the programme
materials.quote: A one-page statement explaining the reasons you are interested in attending the CS MS program at Emory.

Curriculum Vitae/Resume
A document listing relevant experiences and accomplishments, such as internships, awards, and research experiences, that you believe will strengthen your application.

materials.note: unofficial copies, from every post-secondary institution attended
materials.quote: Unofficial copies of transcripts from each post-secondary institution you have attended, including your current one.

materials.note: from an instructor or professional with a computer science orientation
materials.quote: One letter of recommendation from an instructor or professional with a computer science orientation who can speak to your potential for success in advanced studies of computer science.

materials.note: GRE; optional self-report
materials.quote: While the GRE is not required, you are encouraged to self-report your GRE score in your application.

materials.note: if the prior university is outside Canada and English is not its primary language of instruction
materials.quote: Applicants from a university outside Canada in which English is not the primary language of instruction must provide results of an English language proficiency examination as part of their application.

materials.note: from all past post-secondary study
materials.quote: All applicants have to submit transcripts from all past post-secondary study.
Applicants have to submit 3 references to apply to this graduate program.

materials.note: photocopy of the Permanent Resident card; Permanent Residents of Canada only
materials.quote: Permanent Residents of Canada must provide a clear photocopy of both sides of the Permanent Resident card.

materials.note: TOEFL/IELTS; if the Bachelor programme was not conducted in English
materials.quote: TOEFL/IELTS is required for applicants whose Bachelor programme is not conducted in English.

materials.note: proof that the programme was conducted in English; applicants who studied overseas
materials.quote: For applicants studying overseas, please ensure that you submit a relevant proof of documentation that your programme was conducted in English.
Your current resume or CV, including academic and professional experience

materials.note: statement of interest
materials.quote: Your clearly written Statement of Interest (This is a letter explaining your interest in the program, at a maximum of 2 pages).

materials.note: IELTS or TOEFL; international students
materials.quote: Recent IELTS or TOEFL scores (within the last 2 years) required for international students.

materials.note: from all post-secondary institutions attended
materials.quote: Transcripts from all post secondary institutions that you have attended, regardless of whether a degree was completed.

materials.note: academic referees; the applicant enters their contact details
materials.quote: Contact information for 2 Academic References must be entered in the online application.

materials.note: letter from the university stating the length of the degree; only if the transcripts do not state it
materials.quote: If your transcripts do not state this, a letter from the university stating that the degree is a 4-year degree will be accepted.

materials.note: supplementary application
materials.quote:
Supplementary Application
Required
Completed applications (including submission of transcripts and references) are due by January 15 to be considered for September admission.
Completed applications (including submission of transcripts and references) are due by January 15 to be considered for September admission.

materials.note: if the native language is not English and there was no recent year of English-medium post-secondary study
materials.quote: If your native language is not English, and you have not completed at least one full year of study at a post-secondary institution where English is the official language of instruction within 12 months of applying, you must submit results from an accepted English language proficiency test.

materials.note: evidence of professional experience in education; international applicants
materials.quote:
If you are an international applicant, you must provide evidence of the following to be considered for our program:
A four-year undergraduate degree in a field related to education, with a minimum average of 85%.
Two or more years of full-time professional experience in the field of education.

materials.note: evidence of relevant professional experience; for the entry route without a credit average
materials.quote: a bachelor's degree from the University of Sydney, or an equivalent qualification; and the applicant provides evidence of two years of relevant professional experience.

materials.note: evidence of English proficiency; only some applicants (the page says may need)
materials.quote: You may need to provide evidence of your English proficiency to study with us.
